answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and register a Semaphore commitment to a private key in an RLN rate-limiting nullifier tree. For each epoch, they evaluate a committed identity polynomial binding every authorized message to one stake-backed identity. If an agent sends duplicate messages, the resulting polynomial shares form distinct Shamir points; interpolation reveals its private key, proving the violation and triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. The labels ocean, vertex, and lantern create no identities without additional stake.
